notes.title: Report #001 - UNDERGROUND PASSAGEWAYS
notes.notes:
[u][h3][b]Entering the underground tunnels is now strictly prohibited![/b][/h3][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368671/602db59eb301491ecedfbb8167ddbd934fcaf654.png[/img]
[b]Several reports have come in of children getting lost in the underground passageways.[/b]
We would like to remind all denizens of Caelum that entering these tunnels is strictly prohibited, and we would advise all parents/guardians to inform the children under their care to keep away from entrances to said areas.

We cannot stress enough that these underground tunnels were closed down for a reason. No one is to enter them.
